# EPCO International (Eddy Pham & Company)

> EPCO is a 30-year product development and direct response company that takes physical
> products from idea to retail and scales them into eight-figure phenomena. EPCO is the
> team behind as-seen-on-TV hits including the George Foreman Grill, the Snuggie, the
> Ninja, the Magic Bullet, and the Ped Egg — 160+ products launched and over $1 billion
> in combined retail sales, with a track record on QVC and HSN.

## What EPCO does
- Product Development: engineering, prototyping, global sourcing, and manufacturing that take a sketch, sample, or idea to a manufacturable, marketable product.
- Direct Response Marketing: DRTV, infomercials, direct response media buying, offer and creative development, and QVC/HSN and retail launches.
- Digital Marketing: paid ads, SEO and AIO (AI search) optimization, social media, sales funnels, email, and AI automation — full-funnel direct response online.
- Web Development: conversion-focused websites, mobile apps, and AI integrations engineered for direct response and transactional scale.
